scope: Read-only source research for RE5 controlled Jill and original RE4 Bella Sisters; no generation, no remote publication.

references.qualification: Native RE5 unlockable figurine screenshot, reproduced on community firearms reference site; PC UI visible. Exact original RE5 incarnation, no remake face.
references.source_caption: Unlockable figure of Jill Valentine posing with two Skorpion submachine guns.
references.coverage: Full body, both boots and both gun endpoints visible; P30 red chest device, blonde ponytail, purple-blue suit, ribbed dark sleeves, thigh straps.
references.use: Primary full-body/reference pose for controlled Jill RE5.
limits: Figurine pose, not an idle animation.
Near boot is close to lower image edge.
Exact original model texture fidelity not independently certified.

references.qualification: Community-extracted RE5 PC model preview uploaded by sutinoer, January 20 2019, associated OBJ/FBX/DAE archive. Preview only downloaded; model archive not used.
references.coverage: Two full body views: front T-pose and profile facing left. Both heels visible, original blonde head and suit.
references.use: Support for leg, boot and ponytail silhouette.
limits: Community extraction/preview materials cannot certify original rendering.
Do not use as complete sole source for controlled enemy variant.

references.qualification: Community catalogue cutout of RE5 controlled Jill; exact bytes already used by R34 baseline.
references.coverage: Upper body, P30 and head clear, lower body and gun endpoints cropped.
references.use: Head, original face, upper suit and chest device.

references.qualification: Steam user Scarecrow screenshot posted February 8 2015, original Resident Evil 4 Steam app 254700, native in-game Bella Sisters bottlecap menu visible. This is the original 2005 incarnation in its later PC edition, not RE4 remake.
references.coverage: Both figures fully framed with chainsaw tips and shoe tips on native bottlecap base. Front sister crouches, wearing blue-grey buttoned blouse and cream apron over dark skirt; rear sister stands wearing ochre-brown blouse with pale vertical bodice decoration and dark green lower garment.
references.use: Primary original-edition full-figure and clothing reference; one sister per generated asset required.
limits: Two subjects in source with natural overlap; never copy both into one requested asset.
Rear sister far foot not separately established from this front angle.
Long skirts conceal anatomy and most shoes.
Source is 1366x768 with display scanline texture and characters occupy a subsection.
No rear or clean side view.
No independent verification that game installation was entirely unmodified.

references.qualification: Community catalogue render of original RE4, same bytes as baseline.
references.coverage: Both upper bodies, bandages, blouse fastenings and partial chainsaws; legs and weapon tips cropped.
references.use: Higher clarity clothing distinction and bandage appearance supplementary reference.

references.qualification: Original-era RE4 gameplay still in 2010 enemy guide.
references.coverage: Cropped monochrome torso and chainsaw grip.
references.use: None for main body generation; retained research evidence only.
limits: Lower body and blade tip cropped.

excluded_categories: cosplay and action figures as primary native reference
